messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
मैं जूलियो के अधीन भले ही देर से जन्मा, और मैं रोम में अच्छे ऑगस्टस के अधीन रहा उस समय में झूठे और कपटी देवताओं के समय में।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|-------------------|--------| | Nacqui | 1st sg perfect of *nascere* “to be born” | जन्मा | was born | OK | | sub | preposition “under” (temporal/political) | के अधीन | under | OK | | Iulio | proper name “Julio” | जूलियो | Julio | OK | | ancor | adverb “although, even” (concessive) | भले | though | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction introducing subjunctive clause | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | fosse | 3rd sg imperfect subjunctive of *essere* “to be” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tardi | adjective “late” (adverbial) | देर | late | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | और | and | OK | | vissi | 1st sg perfect of *vivere* “to live” | रहा | lived | OK | | a | preposition “at, in” | में | in/at | OK | | Roma | proper name “Rome” | रोम | Rome | OK | | sotto | preposition “under” (political) | के अधीन | under | OK | | ’l | definite article (elided) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | buono | adjective “good” | अच्छे | good | OK | | Augusto | proper name “Augustus” | ऑगस्टस | Augustus | OK | | nel | contraction “in the” | उस | that (demonstrative) | OK | | tempo | noun “time” | समय | time | OK | | de | preposition “of” | के | of | OK | | li | definite article plural “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | dèi | noun “gods” | देवताओं | gods | OK | | falsi | adjective “false” | झूठे | false | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | और | and | OK | | bugiardi | adjective “lying” | कपटी | lying | OK |
### Items flagged in the translation - **UNNECESSARY**: *che, fosse, ’l, li* – omitted because Hindi does not require these particles/articles. - **UNNECESSARY (added by Hindi for fluency)**: the pronoun **मैं** (I) and the particle **ही** in “भले ही”, as well as the second occurrence of **समय में** (repetition of “time” required by Hindi syntax).
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected; all mapped elements agree in gender, number, and case with Hindi grammatical requirements.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: मैं जूलियो के अधीन भले ही देर से जन्मा, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 2: - Original: और मैं रोम में अच्छे ऑगस्टस के अधीन रहा - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 3: - Original: उस समय में झूठे और कपटी देवताओं के समय में। - Issue: redundancy – duplicated “समय में” - Corrected: झूठे और कपटी देवताओं के समय में।
